counterfactual_missing_items: No explicit mention of angiosarcoma subtype or grade
No mention of MYC or HHV8 status
No mention of prior radiation or lymphedema history
decisive_items: Dermis permeated by irregular, slitlike spaces containing erythrocytes and lined by plump oval cells
Cells stained positively with CD31 and were negative for CK5
Cells had pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei
response.rationale: R2 directly captures the diagnostic histopathology (slitlike vascular spaces, CD31 positivity) and clinical context, while C1 only adds anatomical distribution without independent diagnostic weight. The raw spans in R2 are decisive for angiosarcoma; C1's spans are supportive but non-specific.

rejected.why: C1 is an append-only anatomical expansion of R2, adding no new diagnostic evidence; its spans describe lesion location but not the underlying pathology.
